text.en:
Section 1 of Republic Act No. 857 is hereby amended to read as follows;
"Sec. 1. Any public officer or employee or anyone acting under his order or in his place, who shall obstruct,
prohibit, or otherwise prevent an attorney entitled to practice in the courts of the Philippines from visiting and
conferring privately with a person arrested, at any hour of the day or, in urgent cases, of the night, said visit
and conference being requested by the person arrested or by another acting in his behalf, or by a national or
international non-governmental organization duly accredited by the Office of the President, shall be punished
by prision correccional."

All laws, orders, issuances, rules and regulations or parts thereof inconsistent with this Executive
Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect (15) days after publication in the Official Gazette.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 30th day of March, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
eighty-seven.
